Hi Samir,

Thanks for signing up and kicking the tires on Redwood's Hosted API — excited to see BrightLayer evaluating our stack. I took a quick look at your org on the signup form (thanks!) and it looks like you might be focused on document ingestion and embedding-based retrieval. A short 30-minute demo is usually the fastest way to cover:

- Quick product tour (API, model catalog, streaming)
- How we handle latency/cost tradeoffs (batching, caching, quant profiles)
- Questions and next steps (eval resources, Dedicated options)

Are you available for a 30-min slot this week? I have availability:
- Tue 9/1 10:00–12:00 PDT
- Tue 9/1 15:00–16:30 PDT
- Wed 9/2 11:00–12:00 PDT

If it's easier, grab a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min

I've attached a one-pager demo agenda and will include a solutions engineer if you'd like a deeper technical dive.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
